blockers.detail: All 10 MSVC payloads now byte-match official Python/PySide/Shiboken archives; versions 14.39.33520.0 and 14.42.34438.0. Remaining permission: publisher must establish the applicable Microsoft redistribution entitlement and require downstream protective terms (VS 2022 section 4; Python Windows additional conditions). UCRT/API-set copies can instead be excluded before freezing for the Windows-10+ deployment target; native CI must verify their absence and startup.
Implement conditional proprietary redistributable route plus scoped Wintab, XZ public-domain and NCSA notice routes; no source requirement for proprietary runtime.

The stock QtNetwork collector searches Qt/system PATH for these -x64 OpenSSL names; the historical binaries do not match Python and their exact original source directory is unavailable. New Windows QtNetwork hook retains Schannel and does not collect that optional OpenSSL backend. Native re-freeze must prove both DLLs and qopensslbackend.dll absent. Official CPython libcrypto-3.dll/libssl-3.dll already match python.org archive and OpenSSL 3.0.16 license.

New Windows PySide6 hook removes optional opengl32sw.dll for this raster QWidget UI. Verify absence and actual readable qwindows/offscreen frozen smoke in native CI. Historical artifact still contains Mesa and is not approved; complete LLVM/Mesa closure only if it is retained.

Run coverage_windows_ci.py probe-loader on the actual native CI EXE and hash-pinned official 6.13.0 wheel. It compares all non-resource sections plus loader-critical headers/directories and binds the report to discovery/artifact hashes. Parser and official supplier bytes exercised locally; actual frozen native comparison still pending.

Root cause proven in pinned PyInstaller api.py: DATA with os.access(X_OK) becomes type b; Windows access ignores execute bit. 100 supplier-matched entries are DATA, not PE. Shared native_inventory must classify actual magic, safely inspect nested containers, and keep compliance/source archives under their separate verifier instead of self-referential native coverage. Historical 198-entry discovery is preserved.
Exercise exact modified-library/rebuild route and final artifact on native Windows; Linux audit is not a native test.
